projects.title: CloudMetrics — Multi-Cloud Telemetry & Automated Billing Engine
projects.clientType: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Vendor (San Francisco, CA)
projects.description: A high-throughput monitoring platform that ingests server metrics, tracks usage spikes, and automates multi-tier enterprise billing with zero sync latency.

caseStudy.headline: Real-Time Telemetry Streaming and Automated Usage-Based Billing for 300+ Enterprise Tenants
caseStudy.overview: CloudMetrics needed a modern infrastructure to ingest over 8,000 server metric events per second, calculate real-time usage tiers, and execute automated monthly Stripe billing reconciliation across multi-tenant clusters.
caseStudy.clientOverview: Cloud Infrastructure & Telemetry Provider serving DevOps teams across North America and Europe.
caseStudy.challenge: Legacy batch processing resulted in 4-hour data calculation delays, occasional billing discrepancies, and unacceptable dashboard lag during peak network traffic.
caseStudy.solution: We architected an asynchronous event-driven pipeline using Redis Streams, optimized time-partitioned PostgreSQL storage, and engineered a responsive React SPA with live WebSockets.
keyFeatures: Real-time WebSocket telemetry charts with sub-100ms render updates
Automated usage-tier calculation with Stripe Invoicing webhook sync
Fine-grained multi-tenant role-based permissions (RBAC) & audit logs
Customizable dashboard widgets with instant PDF and CSV report exports

developmentProcess.detail: Mapped high-velocity time-series schema and optimized indexing patterns.
Engineered Node.js streaming microservices with strict rate-limiting.
Constructed virtualized data tables, interactive graphs, and dark-mode UI.
Conducted load tests up to 15k events/sec with zero packet loss before rollout.

caseStudy.architectureNotes: Decoupled Next.js frontend on Cloudflare Edge, connecting to microservices backed by TimescaleDB, Redis Cache, and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: OmniPress — Multi-Region Headless Content Hub & Editorial Mesh
projects.clientType: Digital Publishing & Global Media Group (New York, NY)
projects.description: An enterprise headless CMS mesh empowering 120+ editorial staff to draft, review, localize, and publish content across 8 international frontends instantaneously.

caseStudy.headline: Unified Multilingual Content Infrastructure Delivering Sub-Second Page Loads Globally
caseStudy.overview: OmniPress replaces fractured legacy WordPress instances with a centralized, headless Strapi content engine powering multilingual web and mobile applications with edge caching.
caseStudy.clientOverview: International Media Group with 8 localized digital magazines and over 4.5M monthly active readers.
caseStudy.challenge: Editorial bottlenecks caused by slow preview builds, lack of granular workflow permissions, and inconsistent typography across international properties.
caseStudy.solution: Implemented a modular Strapi CMS with custom validation hooks, Next.js Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR), and automated CDN purge pipelines.
keyFeatures: Dynamic visual block builder with side-by-side live mobile preview
Automated multi-language localization workflows with version rollback
Edge-cached GraphQL API delivering responses in under 40ms globally
Granular role-based editorial approval states (Draft, Review, Staged, Published)

developmentProcess.detail: Structured content schemas, relationship graphs, and localization models.
Built Strapi extensions, AWS S3 image optimization, and CDN webhooks.
Created ultra-fast Next.js templates with dynamic OpenGraph generators.
Migrated 85,000 legacy articles without broken links or SEO loss.

caseStudy.architectureNotes: Central Strapi Headless Core behind Cloudflare Enterprise CDN, querying Next.js dynamic static generation on Vercel Edge.

results.label: Reduction in Editorial Publishing Cycle Time

projects.title: LogiOps — Intelligent Fleet Routing & Warehouse Dispatch Portal
projects.clientType: Supply Chain & Regional Logistics Enterprise (Chicago, IL)
projects.description: A purpose-built logistics operations portal featuring live GPS vehicle tracking, automated route payload balancing, and barcode warehouse scanning.

caseStudy.headline: Automating Multi-Hub Fleet Dispatch and Real-Time Warehouse Inventory Scanning
caseStudy.overview: LogiOps streamlined freight dispatch operations across 14 regional hubs, replacing manual phone coordination and spreadsheets with automated algorithm-driven route assignments.
caseStudy.clientOverview: Midwest Freight Network operating 120 commercial vehicles and 14 warehouse fulfillment hubs.
caseStudy.challenge: Manual dispatching caused route inefficiencies, delayed cargo tracking updates, and frequent warehouse check-in bottlenecks.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered an asynchronous Python FastAPI system integrating live telematics, touch-optimized warehouse tablet UIs, and dynamic route optimization.
keyFeatures: Interactive live fleet tracking map with real-time driver status feeds
High-speed QR and barcode scanning module with offline sync
Automated payload distribution engine ensuring zero axle weight violations
Instant automated delivery receipt generation with digital signatures

developmentProcess.detail: Conducted on-site warehouse analysis and dispatch timing benchmarks.
Implemented Dijkstra-based heuristic routing engine in Python.
Built high-contrast responsive interface optimized for rugged tablets.
Completed pilot validation across 20 vehicles before 100% rollout.

caseStudy.architectureNotes: FastAPI asynchronous service cluster with Redis pub/sub for WebSocket map coordinates and relational PostgreSQL backend.

projects.title: FinVault — Multi-Currency Payment Gateway & Ledger Engine
projects.clientType: B2B Financial Services & Cross-Border Payments (London, UK)
projects.description: An enterprise financial gateway facilitating automated multi-currency transfers, instant ledger reconciliation, and strict fraud detection checks.

caseStudy.headline: Sub-Second Multi-Currency Settlements with Double-Entry Cryptographic Ledger
caseStudy.overview: FinVault engineered a modern banking dashboard and API orchestration engine processing over $18M in monthly cross-border transactions across 32 currencies.
caseStudy.clientOverview: Regulated Financial Services Provider connecting international merchants with banking rails.
caseStudy.challenge: Legacy payment bridges suffered from slow FX settlement confirmations, manual reconciliation errors, and opaque transaction auditing.
caseStudy.solution: Built a high-performance Go microservices architecture with Apache Kafka event streaming, strict double-entry ledger bookkeeping, and responsive client portal.
keyFeatures: Instant multi-currency exchange calculations with real-time rate lock
Immutable double-entry ledger tracking every debit and credit transaction
Automated bank statement reconciliation using pattern-matching algorithms
Role-based multi-signatory approval workflows for high-value transfers

developmentProcess.detail: Defined strict financial audit models, idempotency rules, and encryption.
Built transactional Go engine with ACID-compliant PostgreSQL schemas.
Developed React dashboard with live ledger updates and FX conversion widgets.
Passed independent SOC2 and ISO27001 vulnerability assessments.

caseStudy.architectureNotes: Golang microservices handling high-throughput event processing via Apache Kafka, with strict TLS 1.3 encryption and PostgreSQL.

about.headline: Senior Engineering Practice Built for Architectural Longevity
about.lead: We collaborate with ambitious founders, enterprise tech leaders, and growing technology companies to engineer resilient, high-performing digital platforms.
paragraphs: Founded with an engineering-first mindset, Diyaseva Technologies focuses exclusively on designing and developing digital software products that create measurable business impact. We believe that world-class software requires deep architectural foresight, rigorous quality standards, and close alignment with our clients' growth roadmaps.

Whether you are launching a complex multi-tenant SaaS application, transitioning to a flexible headless CMS architecture, or automating mission-critical business workflows, our team delivers modern codebases, transparent sprint communication, and lasting technical value.

termsAndConditions.title: Terms and Conditions
termsAndConditions.subtitle: Please review the general terms governing technology consulting, custom software development, and engineering services provided by Diyaseva Technologies.

sections.title: 1. Agreement & Scope of Services
sections.content: By accessing this website, requesting a technical proposal, or entering into a Statement of Work (SOW) with Diyaseva Technologies, Inc. ("Company", "we", "us", or "our"), you ("Client", "you") agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. Our services include SaaS product engineering, headless CMS implementation, web application development, custom software engineering, UI/UX design, and ongoing technical support as detailed in mutually executed project agreements.

sections.title: 2. Proposals, Estimates & Statements of Work
sections.content: All project timelines, cost estimates, and deliverables described on this portfolio or in preliminary proposals are subject to formal confirmation in an executed Statement of Work. Any modifications to project scope requested during development will be documented and billed according to agreed-upon change order procedures.

sections.title: 3. Intellectual Property Rights
sections.content: Unless otherwise specified in writing in a specific SOW: Upon full receipt of agreed payment, all bespoke source code, visual assets, database schemas, and customized software developed specifically for the Client will become the exclusive property of the Client. The Company retains the rights to pre-existing generic libraries, proprietary developer utilities, and the non-exclusive right to display completed project summaries in its portfolio, unless a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) explicitly prohibits it.

sections.title: 4. Client Obligations & Collaboration
sections.content: Successful project execution relies upon timely communication. The Client agrees to provide necessary access credentials, brand assets, API documentation, feedback, and staging approvals in a timely manner. Delays in providing necessary input may result in corresponding milestone timeline adjustments.

sections.title: 5. Payment Terms & Invoicing
sections.content: Invoices are issued according to project milestones (e.g., initial sprint deposit, design signoff, staging demo, and final production handover) or periodic retainer schedules as outlined in your SOW. Invoices are payable within fourteen (14) days of receipt unless otherwise agreed.

sections.title: 6. Confidentiality & Non-Disclosure
sections.content: Both parties agree to treat all non-public information, proprietary business workflows, customer data, and technical specifications disclosed during the engagement with strict confidentiality. Neither party will disclose such information to third parties without prior written consent.

sections.title: 7. Warranties, Support & Limitation of Liability
sections.content: We warrant that all software delivered will substantially conform to agreed technical specifications for a period of thirty (30) days following production release. To the maximum extent permitted by law, the Company is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from third-party hosting outages, upstream API changes, or unauthorized Client code alterations.

sections.title: 8. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
sections.content: These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California, United States, without regard to its conflict of law principles. Any dispute arising out of this agreement will be resolved through good-faith negotiation, followed if necessary by binding arbitration.

sections.title: 9. Contact Information
sections.content: For questions regarding these Terms and Conditions or to request a tailored Master Services Agreement (MSA), please contact us at legal@diyaseva.com or hello@diyaseva.com.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.subtitle: How we handle data, protect privacy, and ensure client confidentiality when you visit our website or communicate with Diyaseva Technologies.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: As a modern portfolio and engineering studio website, we respect your privacy. When you voluntarily contact us via email, WhatsApp, or contact inquiry links, we receive your email address, name, organization, phone number, and any project specifications you choose to share.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Inquiries
sections.content: Information submitted through direct contact is used exclusively to respond to your project requests, prepare technical proposals, and coordinate software development consultations. We never sell, rent, or trade your contact information to third-party advertisers.

sections.title: 3. Analytics & Cookies
sections.content: We may use lightweight, privacy-focused web telemetry to monitor aggregate page views, device screen sizes, and browser performance to optimize our website's speed and accessibility. We do not track personal identities across other websites.

sections.title: 4. Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security protocols, including TLS 1.3 encryption, secure hosting configurations, and strict internal access controls to protect information transmitted to us.

sections.title: 5. Contact & Rights
sections.content: If you wish to access, rectify, or request the deletion of any personal communications sent to us, please reach out to privacy@diyaseva.com or hello@diyaseva.com.
